subject: Vulnerability SLA matrix & patch ownership confirmation
messages:
From: Alice Dunne <alice.dunne@finsecure.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@finsecure.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vuln mgmt SLA matrix + patch owners for SOC2 refresh

Hi Ben,

FinSecure is doing a SOC 2 refresh and our auditor has asked for a concise mapping of vulnerability management SLAs and operational owners for all external services with access to customer data. Specifically we need:

- A table that maps vulnerability severity (Critical / High / Medium / Low) to target remediation SLA (RCA/patch rolling timeline) and verification method (scan, patch report).
- Who (team & primary contact) owns remediation and PR/patch rollout for each affected component (serving, control plane, onboarding services).
- Weekly scan cadence and proof of last successful scan (CSV export or report).

Can you provide a single matrix + the most recent scan schedule for the next quarter? Auditor is asking for artifacts by EOD Wednesday (US PST) so we can include them in the SOC 2 package.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Dunne
Sr. InfoSec Manager, FinSecure
Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Dunne <alice.dunne@finsecure.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vuln mgmt SLA matrix + patch owners for SOC2 refresh

Hi Alice — appreciate the heads up. We're on it.

Quick plan:
1) I'll attach a compact SLA matrix that maps severity tiers to our remediation target and verification steps.
2) Laura will confirm who owns each component (ops vs infra vs security) and include primary contacts and escalation path.
3) Marcus will export the weekly scan cadence CSV and the latest scan timestamps for the auditor.

We have a slightly different internal naming scheme for severity (P0/P1/P2/P3) — I'll include a crosswalk to Critical/High/Medium/Low in the matrix to avoid confusion.

Expect the files attached here shortly. If the auditor needs a signed attestation, we can add a one-paragraph declaration of our SLA commitments signed by security leadership.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: VM-SLA-Matrix-20280530.xlsx (stub), redwood-weekly-scan-schedule-2028Q2.csv (stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Dunne <alice.dunne@finsecure.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vuln mgmt SLA matrix & patch ownership confirmation

Ben / Alice — adding component ownership and SLA clarifications. See notes inline and in the attached matrix: we mapped Redwood components to owner teams and added the P0-P3 crosswalk. Summary below: 

- Serving runtime (inference nodes): Owner = Infra (Marcus Lin). SLA: P0 (Critical) = 24 hours; P1 (High) = 72 hours; verification = post-patch scan + smoke test.
- Control plane (API/console): Owner = Platform (Laura Bennett). SLA: P0 = 48 hours; P1 = 96 hours; verification = automated regression + weekly auth smoke.
- Customer-managed private deployments: Owner = Customer Success/Escrow (Monica Patel) — we provide remediation guidance and hotfix artifacts; SLA commitments vary by contract (see column G).
- Third-party dependencies (OS libs): Owner = Security (Ben) — we run a dependency intake and either provide a patch or mitigations. SLA: P0 = 48 hours to mitigation plan, 14 days to patch where hardware/compatibility allow.

A couple of operational notes that may be helpful for the auditor:
- Our weeklies run on Tue mornings PST and produce a CSV export with scan ids and timestamps; Marcus included the next quarter schedule.
- For Critical CVEs with public exploitability we open a fast-track ticket and trigger a canary rollout (customers are notified per contract).
- Exceptions for private deployments are documented in customer-specific ROWs; I flagged that in the matrix.

If FinSecure wants formal language for the SOC packet (one-paragraph attestation of our remediation SLAs and practice), we can draft and have Security/Legal sign.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none (matrix attached by Ben)

Marcus
